Add the falsification test: a hostile job publishes a fresh undeclared distinct-content artifact before every budget expiry → the cursor does NOT advance, the floor does NOT move, requeue_count + silent sweeps keep advancing, the lane reaches the telomere floor with EXACTLY ONE operator escalation.
